name: SearchHash
description: Look up a hash against what PolySwarm already knows. Read-only: nothing is submitted, no scan quota is spent, and an unseen hash comes back as unknown rather than an error. Use ScanFile to submit a file for a fresh verdict instead.

query_hash.description: The hash (SHA256, SHA1, or MD5) to look up. Nothing is submitted to PolySwarm: this is a read-only search and spends no scan quota.

detect_threshold.description: How many malicious engine detections activate the detected branch. Default of 1 flags on any single detection.

families.description: Every malware family PolySwarm associates with the artifact, from the normalised engine name and the tag link surface. Empty when PolySwarm carries no family.

family.description: Malware family name, when the metadata carries one

permalink.description: Link to the PolySwarm scan result

tags.description: Tags associated with the artifact on the PolySwarm tag link surface. Empty when there are none or when the plan does not carry tag access.

threat_actor.description: Threat actor named by an actor tag on the artifact. PolySwarm has no dedicated actor field, so this is only populated when a tag names one, and is an empty string otherwise.

found.description: Whether PolySwarm has seen this artifact at all

total_detections.description: How many engines returned a verdict, malicious or benign, excluding those that abstained

outputs.not detected: PolySwarm has scanned this artifact and no engine detected it
outputs.unknown: PolySwarm has never seen this artifact
